description: a lean young woman master archer with long black hair in a high ponytail and a silver diadem with a green gem, elegant black leather armour with silver plates and silver filigree, a silver pauldron shaped like a hawk's wing, a long dark green cloak, black leggings and tall black boots, one single long black recurve bow with silver tips held upright in her right hand at her side, only one bow, no arrow on the string, seen from the side in strict profile: the face, chest, hips and feet all turned fully to the right, only one eye visible, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
